title: TWITTER T8 closed-wheel complete-bike configurations
notes: The exact manufacturer page publishes two T8 closed-wheel builds: WheelTop EVO 24-speed at approximately 9.2 kg and Shimano 105 R7120 24-speed at approximately 9.3 kg. The retained card does not expose enough selected-option detail to choose between them, and the page does not publish a maximum tire clearance.
